newsitem.title: GREECE: UPDATE:BANK OF GREECE DEPUTY GOVERNOR GARGANAS SWORN IN.
newsitem.headline: UPDATE:BANK OF GREECE DEPUTY GOVERNOR GARGANAS SWORN IN.

text.p: New Bank of Greece deputy governor Nickolaos Garganas was sworn in on Thursday before the President of the Republic Costis Stephanopoulos and central bank governor Lukas Papademos.

An economist who studied at the London Scool of Economics, Garganas obtained his PhD from University College London. He worked as research economist at Britain's National Institute for Economic and Social Research during 1968-1975.
Since 1975 he has been an economic advisor to the Bank of Greece and a founding member of the council of economic advisors.

Garganas who replaces outgoing deputy governor Evangelos Kourakos was also the brainchild behind the economic stabilisation programme implemented by Costas Simitis as national economy minister in a previous socialist administration.

Garganas who has closely monitored European integration developments as a member of the EU monetary commission during 1985-87 is also the author of three books and numerous papers on macroeconomic analysis, econometric models, international trade and monetary policy. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
